title: Why Allstate Stock Raced 5% Higher Today
description: Allstate's stock surged to an all-time high after the company announced the sale of its employer voluntary-benefits business for $2 billion. The move is part of Allstate's efforts to exit its health and benefits operations, and analysts believe it could lead to increased share buybacks.

title: Allstate Stock Sinks As Market Gains: Here's Why

title: Hurricane Milton Evacuations 'A Matter Of Life And Death,' Biden Says: Fed's Bostic Says Storm Could Have Significant Economic Impact Over Next 6 Months

title: Is Lemonade Stock a Millionaire Maker?
description: Lemonade, a small insurance company worth $2.2 billion, is trying to disrupt the insurance industry with its digital-first approach. The article discusses Lemonade's potential to be a millionaire-making stock, but also notes the stock's volatility.
